name: side-hide
description: Hides the entire right sidebar (Listening Activity, What's New, Now Playing, Queue, Connect) and its action buttons.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions side-hide.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions side-hide.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/side-hide.js" && spicetify config extensions side-hide.js- && spicetify apply
